title: imgag/T2T_ONT: diploid telomere-to-telomere genome assembly from Oxford Nanopore sequencing (Gross et al. 2026, Nature Communications)
description: Snakemake workflow for haplotype-resolved, near-T2T human genome assembly from Oxford Nanopore ultra-long, HERRO-corrected, and Pore-C reads, plus phased methylation and haplotype-resolved 3D chromatin contact maps. Companion code for Gross et al. 2026, Nature Communications.
